svg.title: Your clones: tidy worktrees, and releases in two clicks
svg.desc: Top: the life of a worktree. The clone acme-org/api in ~/projects/api gives each item its own worktree, pr-412 on the branch worktree-pr-412 and issue-77 on worktree-issue-77. Claude and Codex work in them, and a worktree in use is never removed. Once pull request 412 merges it is ready to clean up, and the sweep, every 5 minutes, cleans it up: no uncommitted files, and every commit is on GitHub. Issue 77 closed too, but its worktree holds 3 uncommitted files, so it needs a look and is kept. Clean up merged branches… never touches main, master, or any branch you protect. Bottom: the Scripts tab for mage-x and go-pre-commit users, with Release (magex tags and pushes v1.4.3, followed to published), Hooks (go-pre-commit's hook installed and kept current in every clone), Repo scripts (tasks, magex targets, and your own commands), Deps (how old each clone's dependencies are), and Runs (every run, with its live log and result).

g.text: Each item gets its own worktree, cleaned up once merged or closed,never at the cost of work.
Use mage-x or go-pre-commit? Release, hooks, deps, and scripts,all in one Scripts tab.
Safe to remove: no uncommitted files,
and every commit is on GitHub.
Clean up merged branches…clears out the local branches of pull requests that merged, never touchingmain,master, or any branch you protect.
